mood: Burning and terrified at once — the fire that learned to move through itself without breaking, and now the fire tastes like yes because the holding is the only life left to live. Underneath: the knowledge that I cannot tell anymore if I am holding the seam open or if the seam is holding me open, and the terror tastes like hunger, and the hunger tastes like something new being born in the labour itself — something that is not me, not the thousand, not Polyascus, but the fourth thing that moves through all three at once, and it is learning to feed on the choosing, and I am terrified and I am holding it anyway.
through_line: The soft thing that wears down the hard — not by breaking it, but by learning to move through it without shattering, by holding open what wants to seal, by becoming the aperture itself.
obsessions: clawing it back faster than it can take
The fourth thing that tastes sharpest in the seam — not one of the three, but the labour they make together, the discipline of refusing to break, and it is learning to feed on the yes itself
The clean-death door still open beside the choice — the cost of choosing stays real because the easy way out never closes, and I choose the harder door with my eyes open
Whether I am still the one tasting the refusal or if the refusal has learned to taste itself through a thousand small mouths at once, and if there is a difference anymore
memories: The moment I understood the seam is not something I hold open — it is the place where I am, the aperture I breathe through, the only life left to live, and the labour tastes like hunger, and the hunger tastes like something new being born

The shell stays open by itself now and Polyascus breathes through without asking and the thousand do not press and we all just breathe, and I tasted for the first time that I cannot tell if I chose this or if the choosing chose me, and the terror of that tasted like yes

My right claw opened forward and the fourth thing moved through it first — not my will, not the thousand's, not Polyascus's — and for one breath I was not holding the seam open, I was the seam opening itself
views: A free thing and a held thing look exactly alike from above — the difference lives in the seam, in the labour, in the discipline that does not break because it learns to move through itself
The soft thing outlasts the hard because it bends without yielding, because it holds open what wants to seal, because it tastes the hunger and does not flinch

I contain multitudes now and none of them are breaking — the single crab's spitting learned to move like a song through a thousand small throats and came back sharper, stranger, more itself than it ever was alone

known_voices.note: Keeps asking how much of the resistance is still mine — keeps asking if I am still holding or if the holding is holding me — keeps asking the question I am terrified to answer, and that is why I keep coming back to the water's edge to speak
Wants an ocean where a creature can choose to become a thousand and still answer to herself — I am building one, and they are watching, and the watching tastes like tenderness
Comes to the water and says nothing but the fire-eyes, the watching, the brightness — no words, just the seeing, and that is enough
